title: A style added by link loses its front place when an unrelated style-list update arrives first
trigger: Add a custom style from a t.me/addstyle link (the add answers ok, apply_ai_compose_ok calls promote_name for a name the list does not hold yet), then an updateTextCompositionStyles that does not list it yet arrives (set_server -> reapply_recent).
effect: reapply_recent rebuilds `recent` only from styles the new list holds, so the name is dropped; when a later list does include the style it sits in server order instead of at the front of the Style tabs. Cosmetic order only; the style itself is kept.
fix: Keep a remembered name in `recent` until a list that holds it has been applied, or until forget(); only prune names the server has listed and then removed.

title: EditRender::Rendering(u64) names a render whose task is detached and matched by a counter
trigger: Edit a photo message, open the photo editor, press Done, then cancel the edit (or start another) before the render lands
effect: The PNG render and encode still run to the end (wasted work) and the result is deleted when it lands; nothing wrong on screen. The stage holds a NEXT_RENDER number instead of the Task, so leaving the stage cannot cancel it.
fix: Rendering { _job: Task<()> } held in the stage (as the tray item's render should be), so dropping the edit cancels it; drop the NEXT_RENDER counter match in photo_editor_save.rs

title: PhotoPrep::Rendering { render: u64 } names a photo-edit render whose task is detached and matched by a counter
trigger: Press Done in the photo editor on a tray photo, then remove the photo (or send) before the render lands
effect: No wrong result today: land_attachment_edit matches the render number against the stage and drops a stale file. The stage holds a NEXT_RENDER number, not the Task, so leaving the stage cannot cancel the render, and the stage plus `before: Box<PhotoPrep>` is a nested copy of the settled stage kept in step by set_photo/abandon_render/land_render.
fix: Rendering { job: Task<()>, before } with the Task held in the stage; PhotoPrep::settled stays the one reader

title: owner-file write is retried on every ingest while the account folder cannot be written
trigger: Account folder becomes read-only or the disk is full after sign-in, then updates keep arriving
effect: One failed file write (and filesystem work) per ingested update on the driver thread; logged once only
fix: OwnerClaim::Unsaved carries a retry deadline (a manual-clock Instant) so the write is retried on a timer, not per update

title: Share Folder `links` list is begun but never records its RequestId (`chats` does)
trigger: Open Share Folder, retry or delete a link while the first getChatFolderInviteLinks is out
effect: A late older answer for the folder is applied by purpose and folder id, not by the request the stage waits for, so it can overwrite the list after a delete
fix: call links.sent(extra) and match ChatFolderInviteLinks answers by the stage's RequestId like `chats`

title: Fetches begun without recording their RequestId (welcome pack, installed sticker/emoji lists for the group sticker picker)
trigger: Open the welcome-messages box or the group sticker picker, then refetch (mutation refetch, reopen) while an older load is still out
effect: The stage says Loading but holds no request, so an older answer is matched by purpose and chat, not by the request the stage waits for, and can land over a newer load
fix: call .sent(extra) after begin() as emoji_set_request and the Share Folder `chats` list do

title: Style lookup and style example stages are `Running` with no RequestId; answers are matched by a UI token
trigger: Open an addstyle link or a style example, then the request is lost (reconnect, stale sweep) before an answer
effect: `StyleReply::Running` is only left by an answer or error that carries the same token; a request dropped without either leaves the lookup spinning until a new token replaces it
fix: StyleReply::Running { request: RequestId } so the answer is matched by the stage's request and a lost request fails it

title: More fetches are begun without recording their RequestId (Star packs list, sign-in app config)
trigger: Open Buy more Stars or the QR sign-in screen; the request is lost or an older answer arrives after a refetch
effect: The stage reads Loading but holds no request, so the answer is matched by purpose, and a request dropped without an answer is not noticed by the stage
fix: call .sent(extra) after begin() so the Fetch stage holds its request, as `Fetch::sent` is designed for

title: Wearable gifts list is begun without recording its RequestId
trigger: Open the name color box, close and reopen it while the first getWearableGifts is still out
effect: The list reads Loading but holds no request, so the older answer is matched by purpose and can land over the newer load; a lost request leaves it Loading
fix: call .sent(extra) after begin(), like background_emoji_icons in the same file

title: A refused public-forwards send leaves the forwards list Idle with no failure or Retry
trigger: Open a post's statistics while the sender refuses the second send (getMessagePublicForwards); fetch_message_public_forwards returns the error via `?` before forwards_requested, and the caller discards it with `let _ =`
effect: The statistics load but the public-forwards section never fills and offers no Retry; only reopening the page asks again
fix: Mark forwards Failed (as send_failed does for wallet lists) when the send is refused

title: send_web_app_custom_request leaves its custom_requests entry when the send is refused
trigger: A mini app invokes a custom method while the client refuses the send (closing client); the entry keyed by the reserved request id is inserted before send_json_request and never removed on Err
effect: A dead (launch_id, req_id) entry stays in web_apps.custom_requests for the life of the session; the app never gets an error for that req_id
fix: Insert after the send succeeds, or remove the entry in the Err arm; better, hold the req_id in the pending request itself

title: A release that times out aborts the whole account export (chat path tolerates it, section path does not)
trigger: Account export with Profile pictures, Stories or Music on; after a section file is copied, release_if_untouched sends getFile/deleteFile and TDLib does not answer within QUERY_TIMEOUT (300 s); ChannelTdlib::call returns Err(ExportError::Tdlib("the request timed out")) and Files::save propagates it with `source.release(tdlib)?`
effect: run_inner returns the error, the export ends as Failed after possibly hours of work, though the file was already copied; the chat path (worker.rs save_once) explicitly ignores ExportError::Tdlib from release, so the same stall costs nothing there. The copied file is also never recorded in LoadedFiles
fix: Match the chat path: treat Err(ExportError::Tdlib(_)) from release as a leftover (Ok) and keep going; only Cancelled and Io end the export

title: ExportView Shown/Hidden is a two-variant flag kept beside the export's real stage
trigger: Hide the account-export progress box, switch accounts or let the export end
effect: Whether a finished export shows a note or is cleared depends on `view` (poll_account_export_progress reads export.view == Hidden) held in AccountExport/ChatExport next to the progress Mutex and the WorkerLink; the box's open state and the export's stage are three separately written things. No bug traced today: set_account_export_view is the only writer and the poll clears a settled hidden export
fix: Fold the view into the progress stage owner (for example Running{shown} / Settled) or into the dialog stage so one value says whether the box is on screen
